officialText:
The posting of signage for portable ramps at inaccessible building entrances where such a ramp is permissible in accordance with the requirements of item 7 of Section 1111.3 of the New York city building code shall be completed on or before March 1, 2020.

(L.L. 2019/122, 6/29/2019, eff. 1/1/2020; Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022; Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2019/122, L.L. 2021/126, and L.L. 2023/077.
previewText: The posting of signage for portable ramps at inaccessible building entrances where such a ramp is permissible in accordance with the requirements of item 7 of Section 1111.
